scoring_justification: Recomputing peak energies and absorption wavelengths from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; the checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper-reported gold within tolerances and also enforces the claimed directional trends using endpoint comparisons.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for E1, E2, E3 (eV) and absorption_peak_nm (nm) for each composition, drawn from the paper's reported figures and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 4: E1 values explicitly listed for n=0..4; E2 values inferred from text (2.51→2.52→2.35→2.20→2.15 eV); E3 values inferred from blue-shift description; absorption wavelengths given (707 nm for Au20, 813 nm for Au17Zn3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper and cross-checked against the reference solve.sh, ensuring internal consistency.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the actual paper-reported numbers or close approximations; they are not invented but derived from the published source.

required.Au20: object with fields E1, E2, E3 (eV) and absorption_peak_nm (nm)
required.Au19Zn1: object with fields E1, E2, E3 (eV)
required.Au18Zn2: object with fields E1, E2, E3 (eV)
required.Au17Zn3: object with fields E1, E2, E3 (eV) and absorption_peak_nm (nm)
required.Au16Zn4: object with fields E1, E2, E3 (eV)

outputs.description: JSON file containing the extracted ε₂ peak energies and optical absorption peak wavelengths for Zn-doped Au20 clusters.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's reported peak energies and absorption wavelengths to the paper-reported values within hidden tolerances and enforces monotonic trends (E1 decreases, E2 decreases, E3 non-decreasing with Zn concentration).
